buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on freshness. Garcia has logged 131 games across 5 matches in 14 days, De Reales only 38 across 2.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: No clear edge on motivation and pressure: two factors pull in opposite directions. Garcia's comeback rate is 36% against 8% for De Reales, which matters if the first set slips away. Over 90 days De Reales' Elo has moved +90 against +72 for Garcia.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: De Reales holds a clear advantage on conditions. De Reales rates +18 Elo points better on Clay than overall; for Garcia it is -31. De Reales has 17 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Garcia only 10, so the adjustment period is shorter.
